policy: Enumerate every legal TL1 macro construction under the 35-Space working model before introducing new combat-balance targets. Space legality and nominal Tactical Power feasibility are separate diagnostics.

powerDiagnostic.policy: Nominal demand means firing every installed main weapon once at its retained TL1 standard setting, readying every installed kinetic PDS, and operating an installed active sensor at its 1-TP setting. Shield maintenance remains core-powered; tactical shield recharge, evasion, overload, and AUX are deliberately excluded. A negative margin is legal construction but proves all nominal systems cannot operate simultaneously from the installed main reactors.

supportSpacePolicy: The enumerator leaves residual Installation Space untyped rather than pretending the AUX/ammunition catalogue is already settled. The current balanced reference uses its 2 residual Space as provisional PDS ammunition support plus one small AUX; future subsystem passes may allocate residual Space differently.

referenceBuilds.description: One main weapon/reactor, active sensor, shield generator, and one kinetic PDS; leaves two Space for provisional ammunition/support and a small AUX.
Two main weapons plus active sensor; no shield or PDS; leaves one Space for support.
Two main reactors plus active sensor; intentionally overbuilt for power and leaves one support Space.
One weapon/reactor with five kinetic PDS installations and no active sensor or shield; exact-fill odd build for later combat testing.
Two main weapons and two kinetic PDS installations; exact-fill offensive/terminal-defense stress build.
One main weapon/reactor, shield generator, and three kinetic PDS installations; leaves one support Space and no active sensor.
Two main weapons and two main reactors before optional systems; this must remain outside the TL1 35-Space envelope.
